origins.section: Duration.ofDays(1) Is 24 Hours; Period.ofDays(1) Is the Next Calendar Day
Period.between Returns Fields; Count Days With ChronoUnit.DAYS.between

recorded.outcome:q-follow-up-call: c (14:00 Sunday) is decided by analogy: lines 38-39 show 07:00+02:00 on 24 Oct + Duration.ofDays(1) = 06:00+01:00 on 25 Oct (Amsterdam); lines 43-46 say Duration.ofDays(1) is 86,400 seconds that move the instant, and October's 25-hour day takes the hour back. The page's example is Amsterdam, not London; the stem supplies the London clock change, so the reader transfers the rule.

recorded.pass:q-days-active: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-days-active: c (16) is decided by lines 77-79: getDays() is the days left over after the whole months; worked examples at lines 73-74. Reader must compute P1M16D (20 Nov -> 20 Dec, then 16 days to 5 Jan) themselves; the page gives the method, not this answer.

recorded.pass:q-annual-discount: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-annual-discount: c is decided by line 104 (P14M equals P1Y2M: false) and line 110 (a Period stores its three fields as given, and equals compares the fields); lines 177-178 repeat it. Small gap: the page never shows Period.parse on a months value >= 12, so 'parse keeps P12M as 12 months' rests on line 110's general statement (line 195 shows parse converting weeks to days, but not touching months).

recorded.outcome:q-negative-label: c (-1 min -15 s) is decided by analogy: lines 147-148/155 show Duration.ofMinutes(-90) printing -1:-30, and lines 161-162 say toHours(), toMinutesPart() and toSecondsPart() of a negative Duration are all negative. The quiz uses toMinutes() (total), which the page does not name; it is inferred from toHours() behaving the same way.

recorded.pass:q-follow-up-call:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-follow-up-call:d: Refuted by line 39 (07:00 -> 06:00, an hour less) and lines 45-46 (October's 25-hour day takes the hour back). The +1 hour direction appears only for the March change (line 36), which is the trap.

recorded.pass:q-days-active:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-days-active:a: Refuted by lines 73-74 and 77-79 (getDays() 3 vs DAYS.between 31; getDays() is a field, not the total), and lines 81, 175-176 (totals come from ChronoUnit.DAYS.between).
recorded.prompt:q-days-active:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-days-active:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-days-active:b: Refuted by the same lines 77-79: getDays() is not any form of the total span. Note: the option's 'says' claims DAYS.between 'counts the start and leaves out the end'; the page never states the inclusive/exclusive convention, though it is consistent with lines 72-74.
recorded.prompt:q-days-active:d: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-days-active:d: Refuted implicitly: line 73 (31 Jan -> 3 Mar is P1M3D over 31 days, not P1M1D as 30-day blocks would give) and line 112 (how many days make a month depends on the month). The page never states 'Period.between does not use 30-day months' outright.
